about.sum:
Our Story
About Lily & Roo
Lily & Roo began with a very personal search.
When our founder, Brittany Preston, was searching for jewellery for her own wedding day, she struggled to find pieces that truly felt right. Everything she discovered either drew attention away from the dress or felt overly trend-led. She wanted something timeless and understated — jewellery that enhanced the look as the perfect finishing touch, rather than becoming the main focus.
She wanted jewellery that complemented the moment, not competed with it. Pieces that felt special enough for a wedding day, yet versatile enough to be worn again and again, on everyday outings, meaningful occasions, and celebrations long after the dress was packed away.
So she decided to create it.
Today, Lily & Roo is led by Brittany, and powered by a team of over 20 women who share a love for thoughtful design and beautifully made jewellery. Over 40% of our jewellery is handmade, and every piece is created with the same care and intention that inspired the brand from the very beginning.

Handmade in the UK: Most of our pieces are made in our UK studio by our talented all-female team of designers and makers. Additional components are produced in the UK, India and Thailand using sustainable, ethical factories carefully selected by us. Whether your piece is solid Gold, Gold-filled or Sterling Silver, where we can, we use recycled materials for our jewellery.
Ethical Stones, Every Time.: Here at Lily & Roo, all of our Diamonds comply with the Kimberley Process Certification Scheme, which is designed to prevent the trade in conflict diamonds. Each stone is carefully selected for its quality and traceability.
Our genuine freshwater pearls are never synthetic, chosen for their natural beauty and lighter footprint.
Our Packaging Is 100% Eco Friendly: Your Lily & Roo packaging is 100% eco-friendly, from the jewellery box to the delivery bag. When it comes to being 100% recyclable, we still have work to do. The great news is, we’re on track to get there soon and we’ll keep you posted.

Privacy policy
Last updated: 24 July 2026
This Privacy Policy explains how Lily & Roo collects, uses, stores and shares your personal information when you visit lilyandroo.com (the “Site”), place an order, contact us or otherwise use our services.
We want you to understand what information we hold, why we need it and the choices available to you.
If you have questions about this policy, would like more information about our privacy practices, wish to exercise your rights or want to make a complaint, please contact us:
Email: info@lilyandroo.com
Post: Lily & Roo, 49 Clarendon Road, Watford WD17 1HP, United Kingdom
The Personal Information We Collect
We collect information about your device, your use of the Site and the details required to process your purchases. We may also collect information when you contact our Client Services team. In this policy, “personal information” means information that identifies you or could reasonably be linked to you.

Terms of service
Overview: The term ‘Lily & Roo’, ‘lilyandroo.com’, ‘us’ or ‘we’ refers to Lily & Roo Ltd. Our company registration number is 11384718 and our registered office address is GNR8, 49 Clarendon Road, Watford, WD17 1HP, United Kingdom. Our registered VAT number is 310275839. The term ‘you’ or ‘customer’ refers to the user or viewer of our Website or the person buying or requesting services and/or products from Lily & Roo Ltd.
By visiting our site and/ or purchasing something from us, you engage in our "Service" and agree to be bound by the following terms and conditions ("Terms of Service", "Terms"), including those additional terms and conditions and policies referenced herein and/or available by hyperlink. These Terms of Service apply to all users of the site, including without limitation users who are browsers, vendors, customers, merchants, and/ or contributors of…

Refund policy
At Lily & Roo, we strive to provide the highest quality products and service. We understand that there may be occasions when you wish to return an item, and we want to make the process as straightforward as possible.
Start your return using our returns portal
The returns portal is currently available for orders returned from the UK, Australia, Canada, Finland, France, Germany, Ireland, the Netherlands, New Zealand, Sweden and the USA. For returns from any other country, please contact our Client Services team for assistance.
Important: Duties, Import Taxes and State Sales Tax
If your order was sent Delivered Duty Paid (DDP), the product price may include import duties, tariffs and import taxes paid on your behalf to the relevant customs or tax authorities.
For change-of-mind returns, including unwanted items or items that do not suit, the portion of the order value attributable to import duties, tariffs and import taxes will be deducted from your refund and will not be refunded by Lily & Roo, except where a refund is required by applicable law.
